title: coverage-manifest
description: Per-file record of test coverage for the !test-coverage playbook. Source of truth for which production files have been tested, when, and at which commit. One entry per production file — if the same file is re-tested later, the entry is updated in place (not appended).

file.description: Production file path, relative to repo root.

test_file.description: Test file path, relative to repo root.

tier.description: Classification from Step 4 of the playbook.

last_tested_commit.description: 40-char SHA of the commit that produced the current test coverage for this file.

coverage_after.description: Statement coverage percentage after the test PR merged.

pr.description: URL of the PR that produced this coverage entry.
